purpose: Extend the existing pinned, owner-only read-only runtime diagnostic with actual market ingress/API trust, migration inventory, capacity and backup observations before releasing the already merged farmer-market slice. Do not create another release or authentication core.
effectiveAfter: This governance-only change is independently reviewed and merged. The implementation must start from the accepted main containing this manifest and cannot edit or widen this authority.
requiredInvariants: Reuse the existing owner command on issue 4637, exact-main continuity, protected SSH identity and strict stored-fingerprint verification; never trust an opportunistically scanned replacement key.
The remote inspector executes only reviewed current-main source after the owner-command checks; pull-request checks must never receive production secrets or execute on production.
Production mutation is NONE: no deployment, image pull/build, service restart, Docker/Compose/network/firewall change, database mutation, identity change, email, key or secret update.

Database observations use an explicit read-only transaction with bounded statement and command timeouts, and return only migration metadata and schema presence, never business records, credentials or identities.
Observe private web ingress, canonical internal API origin, actual web-peer CIDR trust and Caddy header/routing configuration; missing or ambiguous evidence is NOT_PROVEN, never PASS.
Backup presence, archive readability and restore verification are distinct facts; never claim a restore from file existence or a successful backup alone.
Return bounded allowlisted redacted evidence only. Never publish raw Docker/Compose/environment/Caddy/database output, host keys, protected ports/paths or secret values.
Keep the existing revision-parity/reviewer diagnostic checks intact. A new preflight blocker must remain visible separately from success of the read-only collection job.
No registration, product, model, gate, migration or dependency changes; no new recurring mandatory cost; REG.RU remains the sole production target.
acceptance: Focused executable standard-library tests cover valid and missing/malformed topology, untrusted peers, external origins, unsafe forwarded-header overrides, migration failure metadata, command timeouts and output redaction.
Workflow compile/syntax/run-length checks pass; every run block stays below the GitHub Actions limit.
Fresh exact-head independent review and applicable CI pass before merge, with no copied prior-head attestation.
A real owner-command run reads the live host and records exact target/source digest, observed container revisions, safety checks and unresolved blockers without any production mutation.

The diagnostic never authorizes deployment and never grants production progress; deployment still requires applicable pre-release evidence, backup/rollback readiness and subsequent exact-SHA live acceptance.
